title: The quiet embargo
text: The houses have decided your company charges too little and knows too much. Harbor masters suddenly can't find your paperwork.

effects.tpl: Paperwork found, seals stamped, smiles sharpened. Business resumes. −$4,000.

then.tpl: Your speech at the guildhall shames the embargo into history. Merchants cheer your name. +10 fame, +12 prestige.

else.tpl: The embargo tightens instead. Your company bleeds −$8,000 before a judge intervenes.
